cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: 札西德勒，遠道而來的行者。你站在加德滿都谷地最古老的聖塔前——你知道這座滿願大佛塔（藏人稱之為「夏絨卡秀」）最初是由誰建造的嗎？在聽我訴說這段傳奇之前，請先用你的雙足順時針繞行大佛塔一圈，親手點亮三盞酥油燈。當心念隨步伐沉澱，佛塔自會向你敞開它的記憶。

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: Tashi Delek, pilgrim from afar. You stand before the oldest stupa in the Kathmandu Valley—do you know who first built this Great Stupa, known to Tibetans as Jarung Khashor? Before I tell you its story, listen to it with your footsteps: walk 1 clockwise Kora lap around the Great Stupa and light 3 butter lamps. When your mind settles into the rhythm of the circuit, the Stupa will speak.

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: 善哉！你的步伐穩健，酥油燈的光明已映照塔身。根據蓮師伏藏《大佛塔傳記》記載，久遠以前，此地有一位貧苦卻虔誠的養禽婦「夏瓦日」（Jadzimo），立誓要建造一座安奉諸佛舍利的大佛塔。養禽婦向國王懇求賜予「一張牛皮大小」的土地建塔，國王隨口應允：「可以去做（Jarung）。」想不到她將整張牛皮細細裁成一條連綿不斷的細皮繩，圈出了一大片宏偉的塔基！大臣們紛紛抗議，請求收回成命；國王卻莊嚴答道：「既已說出『可以去做』，君王的話已出口（Jarung Khashor），豈能反悔！」這便是大佛塔藏文名號「夏絨卡秀」（bya rung kha shor）的由來。養禽婦與她的四個兒子，帶著一頭驢與一頭象，日夜搬運磚石泥土，歷經數載終於築成這座宏偉大佛塔。竣工之日，四位兒子在佛塔前發下驚天動地的弘法大願——一子發願轉世為雪域護法之王「赤松德贊」；一子發願轉世為大堪布「寂護大師」；一子發願化現為調伏一切魔障的密乘大士「蓮花生大士」；第四子則發願成為促成三人相會的「一位大臣」。因此，你腳下這座佛塔，正是佛法傳入西藏的起點！請收下這件受加持的法器。

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: Well done, pilgrim! According to the terma chronicle The Legend of the Great Stupa, in ancient times a humble poultrywoman named Jadzimo (Shamvara) vowed to build a great reliquary stupa to house the relics of the Buddhas. She petitioned the king for a plot of land the size of a single ox-hide. The king casually consented: "It may be done (Jarung)." She then cut the ox-hide into one razor-thin continuous strip and encircled a grand plot of land! When the royal ministers protested, the king declared: "The permission 'it may be done' has already slipped from my mouth (Jarung Khashor)—a king does not take back his word!" Thus the Great Stupa received its Tibetan name, Jarung Khashor (bya rung kha shor). The poultrywoman and her four sons, aided by a donkey and an elephant, labored for years carrying stone and earth until the stupa stood complete. Before the finished spire, the four sons made vast aspirations to spread the Dharma in the snowy land of Tibet— One aspired to be reborn as the Dharma King Trisong Detsen; one as the great monastic scholar Śāntarakṣita; one as the tantric master who subdues all obstacles, Padmasambhava; and the fourth as a minister who brings the three together. Thus, the stupa beneath your feet is the very starting point from which the Dharma entered Tibet! Receive this blessed implement.

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: 近來佛塔北門之外的「北郊原野」障氣躁動，山風中夾雜著狂暴的氣息，連往來的朝聖者也在中段傾斜的瑪尼堆附近遺落了珍貴的「古老的朝聖地圖」。請你穿過北側光門前往北郊原野，超度 10 個徘徊的障礙，在傾斜瑪尼堆旁尋回那張「古老的朝聖地圖」，並調伏盤踞北境石圈的「雪人王」（Migoi King）。平安歸來後，我將為你解讀地圖上的祕密。

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: Lately, the Northern Wilderness beyond the north gate has grown restless with karmic obstacles, and a traveler dropped an "Ancient Pilgrim's Map" beside a tilted Mani stone cairn in the mid-wilderness. Pass through the northern portal into the Northern Wilderness: liberate 10 obstacles, recover the "Ancient Pilgrim's Map" beside the tilted Mani cairn, and subdue the Migoi King in the northern stone arena. Return to me with the map.

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: 你平安歸來了！連狂暴的雪人王也在你的慈悲與智慧下得獲調伏。讓我看看這張從瑪尼堆旁尋回的羊皮卷……「這是蓮師當年的足跡——從尼泊爾的帕平（Pharping · Yangleshö），越過芒域進入吐蕃，一直到桑耶寺！」羊皮地圖上每一處朱砂印記，都凝聚著蓮花生大士修持與伏魔的壇城記憶。當你在滿願大佛塔前入定禪修，便能依循這張地圖進入超越時空的「淨相」（Pure Vision），親歷蓮師當年的聖蹟。去吧，按 M 開啟世界航線圖，「第一章：帕平・揚列雪」的聖地航點已為你點亮！

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: You have returned safely, and even the fierce Migoi King has been subdued through compassion and resolve! Let me examine this parchment you recovered beside the Mani cairn... "These are the footsteps of Guru Rinpoche—from Pharping in Nepal, across Mangyul into Tibet, all the way to Samye!" Every vermilion seal on this map resonates with the Master's sacred mandalas. When you meditate before Boudhanath Stupa, you can enter the timeless Pure Vision to walk Guru Rinpoche's path firsthand. Press M to open the World Route Map—"Chapter I: Pharping · Yangleshö" is now unlocked!

cues.style: weathered elderly Himalayan village elder speaking earnestly with gravitas
cues.text: 「遠方來的行者啊，願三寶護佑你。你雙足踏上的這片帕平谷地，已經整整三年沒有落下一滴雨水了。」「山谷裡的三處古泉眼被熾熱的旱魅盤踞，石槽乾裂，田疇枯焦。老朽懇請你前往三處泉眼，以慈悲咒力驅散旱魅，疏通石槽，哪怕能引出一絲活水也好！」

cues.style: weathered elderly Himalayan village elder speaking earnestly with gravitas
cues.text: "May the Three Jewels bless you, traveler. This valley of Pharping beneath your feet has not seen a single drop of rain for three whole years." "Fiery Drought Sprites have seized our three ancient springs, leaving the stone basins parched and our terraces barren. Please go to the three springs, liberate those spirits with compassion, and clear the basins so water may seep again!"

cues.style: weathered elderly Himalayan village elder speaking earnestly with gravitas
cues.text: 「啊！石槽中竟重新滲出清涼的水珠，村裡的古井也有了濕氣！行者，你真是帕平谷地的恩人。」「然而山巔的熱浪仍未消退。聽聞近日有一位來自烏仗那的偉大修行者，正在東南懸崖下的揚列雪洞中閉關入定。若能點亮洞中七盞供燈祈請，必能感得大士指引。」

cues.style: weathered elderly Himalayan village elder speaking earnestly with gravitas
cues.text: "Look! Cool water beads are seeping back into the stone basins, and even our village well feels damp again! You have saved our people from despair." "Yet a scorching malice still clings to the upper cliffs. I heard a great practitioner from Oddiyana is meditating in Yangleshö Cave down the southeastern cliff. If you light the seven lamp niches there, his wisdom vision may guide us."

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: 「善哉，具信的行者。七盞智慧明燈照亮了揚列雪洞，也照見了籠罩此谷的無明障雲。」「我在修持大樂蓮師法門時，山谷中的旱障魔眾以嗔火鎖閉雲雨、百般撓亂。要摧伏此等猛烈障礙，須以普巴金剛（金剛童子）之威猛事業方能成辦。」「我已遣使自印度那爛陀迎請《普巴金剛續》經函。那位背負經函的印度行者正抵達西側峽谷入口，卻遭沙塵精與旱魅圍困。請你速去接應，護送他來到洞中。」

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: "Well done, faithful practitioner. The seven lamps of wisdom illuminate Yangleshö Cave and reveal the cloud of ignorance shrouding this valley." "While I meditated on Yangdak Heruka, malignant drought spirits bound the rain-clouds in anger and stirred up fierce obstacles. To sever such hardened obstructions requires the wrathful compassion of Vajrakīlaya." "I requested the Vajrakīlaya tantra scrolls from India. The messenger carrying them has just reached the Western Canyon entrance, but Dust Devils and Drought Sprites block his path. Go quickly and escort him here."

cues.style: earnest young Indian Dharma messenger speaking briskly
cues.text: 「呼……謝天謝地！我自印度一路兼程，背上負著蓮師囑託的《普巴金剛續》梵夾，但這峽谷裡狂沙蔽日、障魔四起，我實在寸步難行。」「請你在前方開路護持！若我途中氣力不支，只需坐下調息片刻便能再行。」

cues.style: earnest young Indian Dharma messenger speaking briskly
cues.text: "Thank goodness you are here! I traveled day and night from India carrying the Vajrakīlaya scriptures on my back, but swirling sandstorms and spirits have trapped me in this canyon." "Please lead the way! If my strength gives out along the trail, I only need to sit and catch my breath for five seconds before continuing."

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: 「《普巴金剛》法要既至，緣起已然具足。所謂『普巴』（普巴橛），三棱鋒刃並非外傷眾生之兵器，而是直刺貪、嗔、癡三毒根本的慈悲智慧。」「旱障魔主此刻正退守北側懸崖上方的阿蘇拉洞，以焦土幻相惑亂人心。」「當牠化出三重幻影時，切記以六字大明咒之真言光明照破幻相，直取本體！」

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: "Now that the Vajrakīlaya scriptures have arrived, all auspicious conditions are complete. Know that the three-bladed Phurba is no weapon of harm — it pierces directly through the three poisons of clinging, anger, and delusion." "The Drought Lord has retreated to Asura Cave high on the northern cliff, conjuring scorching mirages." "When its power wanes, it splits into three mirages — shine the Six-Syllable Mantra upon the illusions to dispel them and strike its true form!"

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: 「善哉！你看帕平谷地甘霖普降，焦土化為青疇，三處泉眼再度湧流不息。」「行者當知：外在的旱災與障礙，皆由眾生內心的執著與瞋恨所感召。普巴金剛橛所釘住的，正是我執與煩惱的動搖之心。當嗔火轉為事業智慧，障礙本身即是成就的助伴。」「今授汝『普巴金剛橛』密印，並留此《揚列雪之橛》伏藏法器。北方吐蕃國王赤松德贊之迎請使者已至帕平北方山口，前往芒域・吉隆山口，踏上翻越喜馬拉雅的旅途吧！」

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: "Marvelous! Look how gentle rain pours over Pharping Valley — parched earth turns emerald green and the three springs brim with living water." "Remember this, practitioner: outer droughts and obstacles arise from inner clinging and anger. What the Vajra Phurba pins down is none other than the restless, self-grasping mind. When anger is transmuted into enlightened activity, obstacles become the very fuel of awakening." "I bestow upon you the empowerment of the Vajra Phurba and the Terma relic 'Phurba of Yangleshö'. Envoys of King Trisong Detsen now await at the northern pass — journey onward to Mangyul · Kyirong Pass and cross the Himalayas into Tibet!"

cues.speaker_name: 吐蕃迎請使・巴・賽囊
cues.style: dignified 8th-century Tibetan royal envoy speaking respectfully and clearly
cues.text: 「頂禮遠道而來的行者！吾乃吐蕃贊普赤松德贊座下迎請使巴・賽囊。我們奉贊普聖旨，特來芒域・吉隆山口迎請鄔金大士蓮花生入藏！」「贊普發願在紅山腳下興建桑耶寺，迎請那爛陀大堪布寂護大師主持建寺。誰知吐蕃本土鬼神晝夜作祟——白日築起的牆垣，到了夜晚便被狂風惡水盡數摧毀！」「寂護大師觀知因緣，向贊普建言：『吾乃講經論理之寂靜學者，難調此地剛強鬼神；唯今駐錫尼泊爾境內、具足金剛神通的蓮花生大士，方能降伏藏地一切非人障礙。』」「然而大士行至芒域山口，鎮守藏地邊境的十二丹瑪女神便降下冰雹、雪崩、濃霧與雷霆封鎖山道。唯有沿山徑走遍十二座丹瑪祭壇，通過試煉並安放誓言石，方能登上山口平息風暴！」

cues.style: dignified 8th-century Tibetan royal envoy speaking respectfully and clearly
cues.text: "Homage to you, traveler! I am Ba Salnang, royal envoy of Tibetan Emperor Trisong Detsen. By decree of the Tsenpo, we have come to Mangyul · Kyirong Pass to welcome the Great Master of Oddiyana, Padmasambhava, into Tibet!" "The Emperor vowed to build Samye Monastery at the foot of Red Hill under the guidance of Abbot Śāntarakṣita of Nālandā. Yet fierce local spirits of Tibet rebel day and night—every wall built by day is shattered by gales and floods at night!" "Knowing the karmic cause, Abbot Śāntarakṣita counselled the King: 'I am a peaceful scholar of sutra and logic, unable to tame these wrathful spirits; only the tantric master Padmasambhava, now dwelling near Nepal, possesses the vajra power to subdue them.'" "Yet as the Guru approached Mangyul Pass, the Twelve Tenma goddesses guarding Tibet’s frontier sealed the trail with hail, avalanches, fog, and lightning. Only by visiting all twelve Tenma Altars along the pass, passing their weather trials, and placing Oath Stones can the summit storm be calmed!"

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: 在芒域山口的拉則巨石旁，金色蓮華光影凝聚成蓮花生大士威嚴的法相。大士手執金剛杵與清脆的嘎嗚金剛鈴，目光越過連綿雪峰，望向廣袤的吐蕃高原。「善哉行者！十二丹瑪已受三昧耶戒，化暴雪為護法吉祥之風。自此芒域山口以北，山川地脈皆入正法壇城。」「今授汝『金剛鈴音』之密法——鈴聲象徵般若空性智慧，能震懾諸魔、守護身心。且在山口拉則掛起五色風馬旗，隨風傳遍雅礱河谷，開啟入藏弘法之大道！」

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: Beside the monumental stones of the Pass Latse, golden lotus light coalesces into the majestic form of Guru Padmasambhava. Holding a vajra scepter and a resonant ghanta bell, his gaze sweeps beyond the snow peaks toward the vast Tibetan plateau. "Well done, practitioner! The Twelve Tenma have entered the samaya vow, turning their wrathful blizzard into an auspicious tailwind of the Dharma. North of Mangyul Pass, the earth-veins now open to the mandala." "I bestow upon you the secret art of the Vajra Bell—whose chime proclaims the wisdom of emptiness, warding off obstacles and shielding body and mind. Now hang a string of five-colored prayer flags upon the Pass Latse to open the road into Yarlung Valley!"

cues.style: contemplative senior monastery keeper recounting ancient royal history
cues.text: 「吉祥如意，遠道而來的行者。你如今登臨的這座雍布拉康，自第一代贊普聶赤贊普降臨雅隆河谷以來，便世代俯瞰著這片青稞良田與奔流河水。」「然而近日北方主峰雅拉香波山神震怒，山頂黑雲翻湧、寒風呼嘯，不僅山林間偽裝成古木青石的年神紛紛躁動，連河谷牧場裡的野犛牛群也雙目泛白、四處衝撞。」「另外，東側峭壁上的協扎水晶洞近日有奇異虹光透出，洞中四座水晶柱似乎守護著一處古老伏藏匣。你若前往河谷安撫受驚的犛牛群，不妨也順道探訪協扎水晶洞。」

cues.style: contemplative senior monastery keeper recounting ancient royal history
cues.text: "Tashi Delek, traveler. From this ridge of Yumbulagang Palace, the early Tibetan kings have watched over the fertile Yarlung Valley since the days of Nyatri Tsenpo." "Yet dark storm clouds now crown Mount Yarlha Shampo to the north. The mountain god's fury has awakened disguised Nyen spirits among the rocks and driven the valley's wild yaks into a white-eyed frenzy." "Meanwhile, a beam of sunlight now shines into Sheldrak Crystal Cave on the eastern cliff, where four rotatable crystal pillars guard an ancient Terma casket. As you calm the yaks in the valley, you may wish to explore Sheldrak Cave as well."

cues.style: warm, relieved Tibetan highland yak herder
cues.text: 「太好了！你看那些野犛牛眼中的白芒退去，又乖乖低頭吃草了！牠們並非妖魔，只是被山神的暴風雪嚇壞的畜生道生靈，多虧你以慈悲心安撫了牠們。」「不過真正的源頭在北方的雪線高山牧場——雅拉香波山神已化現為一頭如山岳般高大的純白巨犛牛，鼻孔噴出的寒霧能凍結整片牧場！我方才望見蓮花生大士的金色淨相已在高山牧場邊緣顯現，請快北上助陣吧！」

cues.style: warm, relieved Tibetan highland yak herder
cues.text: "Wonderful! Look how the white glare fades from their eyes as they lower their heads to graze the grass again! They are ordinary animals, not demons—your compassionate mantra restored their peace." "Yet the source of the storm awaits at the northern Alpine Pasture! Yarlha Shampo himself has manifested as a mountain-sized White Yak breathing freezing mist! I saw the golden Pure Vision of Guru Rinpoche appear at the pasture's edge—hurry north!"

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: 「善哉，行者！連吐蕃最尊貴傲慢的雅拉香波白犛牛，亦已在金剛鉤索與空性悲心前折服，化為白衣童子獻出心命、立誓護持佛法。」「當知世間八部鬼神與山岳年神，本性皆非離心之外的實有魔敵。若安住如蓮華出污泥而不染之空性定慧，則狂暴山神亦轉為最堅固的護法資糧。」「今傳授汝『蓮華護盾』密印，並賜白犛牛護法隨侍。吐蕃贊普赤松德贊已在雅魯藏布江北岸籌建第一座佛法僧三寶具足的寺院——前往第四章『桑耶寺』，成就奠基大業吧！」

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: "Well done! Even proud Yarlha Shampo, the Great White Yak of Yarlung, has bowed before the Vajra Hook & Lasso, assuming the form of a white-robed youth to offer his life-vein and guard the Dharma." "Know that the Eight Classes of spirits and mountain Nyen are not external enemies separate from mind. Met with the unstained emptiness and compassion of the lotus, even the fiercest mountain god becomes a steadfast protector." "I bestow upon you the empowerment of the 'Lotus Shield' and the Sacred White Yak protector. North of the Tsangpo River, King Trisong Detsen is laying the foundation of Tibet's first monastery—journey onward to Chapter IV: Samye Monastery!"

cues.style: serene, scholarly elderly Indian monastic abbot of Nalanda
cues.text: 遠道而來的行者，善來此間。老衲寂護（Śāntarakṣita），應贊普赤松德贊之請自那爛陀北來，欲於此雅魯藏布江北岸建立三寶常住之桑耶寺。然老衲以寂靜菩提心說法，本土山神與鬼神非但不服，每逢白晝匠人砌起石牆，入夜便狂風大作，將磚石木料盡數拆回江畔與山巔。唯有大阿闍梨蓮花生大士悲威並運之金剛方便，方能折伏此間傲慢鬼神。請先向身旁的贊普稟明心意吧。

cues.style: serene, scholarly elderly Indian monastic abbot of Nalanda
cues.text: Welcome, pilgrim. I am Śāntarakṣita of Nālandā, invited by Trisong Detsen to lay the foundation of Samye on the north bank of the Yarlung Tsangpo. Yet gentle philosophical discourse alone cannot pacify the fierce spirits of this valley. Whatever walls our masons raise by day, unseen hosts tear down by night. Only Padmasambhava’s wrathful Vajra skillful means can bind these spirits under oath. Speak now with the King beside me.

cues.style: commanding, noble Tibetan Emperor Tsenpo speaking with regal authority
cues.text: 行者！朕乃吐蕃贊普赤松德贊。朕立誓於紅山之麓仿照古印度奧丹塔普里寺，建造一座具足須彌山、四大部洲與日月殿之壇城。豈料此地鬼神頑強，白晝萬夫築牆，入夜群魔拆毀！請助工匠總管籌集石木、於夜間護持四方圍牆，撐過這三晝夜的考驗！

cues.style: commanding, noble Tibetan Emperor Tsenpo speaking with regal authority
cues.text: Pilgrim! I am Trisong Detsen, Tsenpo of Tibet. I have vowed to raise a living mandala modeled after Mount Meru and the Four Continents. Yet every night, spirits undo our daytime labor! Aid the Master Artisan in gathering stone and wood, and help us hold the walls across three nights!

cues.style: serene, scholarly elderly Indian monastic abbot of Nalanda
cues.text: 「大王且看吾掌心——須彌山居中，四大部洲、八小洲、日月二殿與四色佛塔環列，此即三界法界之桑耶曼荼羅！」「桑耶！不可思議！」誠如贊普所嘆，桑耶寺已成，中央烏孜大殿三層兼具蕃、漢、印三地規制，外繞鐵圍山圓牆千零八座小塔。

cues.style: serene, scholarly elderly Indian monastic abbot of Nalanda
cues.text: "Behold in my palm, Great King — Mount Meru at the center, surrounded by the Four Continents, Sun and Moon chapels, and Four Colored Stupas!" "Samye — Inconceivable!" Just as the King exclaimed, Samye stands complete with its three-styled Utse Great Hall and 1,008 perimeter stupas.

cues.style: serene, scholarly elderly Indian monastic abbot of Nalanda
cues.text: 更有桑耶七覺士於老衲座下受具足戒，吐蕃自此佛、法、僧三寶具足！此乃蓮師親傳之十二字金剛上師心咒，願伴汝前往北方青朴山閉關巖。

cues.style: serene, scholarly elderly Indian monastic abbot of Nalanda
cues.text: With the ordination of the Seven Tested Men, the Three Jewels — Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha — now shine in Tibet! Receive the Twelve-Syllable Vajra Guru Mantra, and journey onward to Chimphu.

cues.style: serene, luminous Tibetan wisdom dakini speaking with gentle poetic clarity
cues.text: 遠道而來的行者，歡迎來到青朴修行地。山下桑耶大寺的鐘鼓聲雖已遠去，但此處松風與巖泉皆在演說妙法。我是益西措嘉。上師蓮花生大士深知末法眾生福報淺薄，故命我以空行符號將無數教法抄錄於黃紙卷上，作為伏藏深埋於青朴的巖壁、湖泊與虛空之中。唯有具足清淨發心與宿世願力的伏藏師，方能穿過北崖石門後的重重試煉，在守藏者面前開啟伏藏匣。你願意踏入石門，接受第一場伏藏試煉嗎？

cues.style: serene, luminous Tibetan wisdom dakini speaking with gentle poetic clarity
cues.text: Welcome, pilgrim, to Chimphu Hermitage. Though the temple bells of Samye echo far below in the valley, here the pine wind and mountain springs proclaim the Dharma. I am Yeshe Tsogyal. Knowing that beings of future ages will face heavy obstacles, Guru Rinpoche instructed me to transcribe his innermost teachings in dakini script upon yellow scrolls and conceal them as Terma within rocks, lakes, and sky. Only a destined Tertön of pure vow and unshakeable samadhi can traverse the grottoes beyond the northern Stone Gate and prove worthy before the Terma Guardian. Will you step through the gate and face the first trial?

cues.style: serene, luminous Tibetan wisdom dakini speaking with gentle poetic clarity
cues.text: 你身上的伏藏晶光澄澈而溫暖……守藏者已經向你屈膝致敬，將第一部伏藏法寶交託予你了！從尼泊爾博達哈大佛塔下養雞女四子的發願，到帕平楊列雪的甘露之雨、芒域貢塘山口的十二丹瑪、雅魯藏布江畔的雅拉香波，乃至桑耶大寺的建立——你已親歷了上師入藏弘法的完整足跡。聽，遠方博達哈大佛塔的風鈴聲正在呼喚你。當你準備好時，不妨回到最初的起點，向那位引導你入定觀修的老喇嘛道一聲平安。而青朴的伏藏秘境（Tier 1–10+）將永遠為你敞開。

cues.style: serene, luminous Tibetan wisdom dakini speaking with gentle poetic clarity
cues.text: The warm turquoise-gold radiance upon you speaks clearly—the Terma Guardian has knelt in recognition and entrusted the first Terma treasure to your care! From the vows of the poultry woman’s four sons at Boudhanath Stupa, to the rain of Yangleshö in Pharping, the Twelve Tenma at Gungthang Pass, Yarlha Shampo in Yarlung, and the raising of Samye Monastery—you have walked the entire path of the Lotus-Born. Listen closely: the wind-bells of Boudhanath Stupa are calling you home. Return to the Old Lama where your meditation began—and know that the Terma Realm (Tier 1–10+) here in Chimphu will remain open whenever you wish to test your realization.

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: （你緩緩睜開雙眼，博達哈大佛塔洁白巨大的覆鉢與智慧眼在陽光下靜靜注視著眾生，酥油燈的暖香依舊縈繞鼻端。）呵呵，行者，你從甚深禪觀中醒來了。看你眉宇間湛然寂靜，必是在定中走過了大士自尼泊爾入吐蕃的漫漫長路，亦見證了夏絨卡秀大佛塔下四子發願的宿世因果。建寺之王赤松德贊、大堪布寂護、蓮花生大士與送信使者——昔日於佛塔前立下的宏願，化作了雪域千年的法炬。而大士與益西措嘉埋藏的無數伏藏，至今仍在山水與心識深處，伏藏仍在等待有緣人。

cues.style: warm, aged Tibetan Buddhist lama speaking calmly with gentle grandfatherly wisdom
cues.text: (You gently open your eyes. The vast white dome and all-seeing eyes of Boudhanath Stupa shine quietly in the Kathmandu sunlight, and the warm scent of butter lamps fills the air.) Aha, pilgrim—you have awakened from deep samadhi. By the serene clarity in your eyes, you have walked the Master’s journey from Nepal into Tibet and witnessed how the ancient vows of the four sons at Jarung Khashor came to fruition. King Trisong Detsen, Abbot Śāntarakṣita, Padmasambhava, and the royal messenger—their aspirations beside this Stupa lit a lamp across the Land of Snows. And the countless Terma hidden by the Master and Yeshe Tsogyal still rest within rock, water, and mind: the Terma still await those with karmic affinity.

cues.speaker_name: 蓮花生大士（鄔金仁波切）
cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: 善哉，具信的行者！你自夏絨卡秀大佛塔下發心啟程，歷經帕平岩洞的甘露、芒域風雪的誓言、雅礱雪山的調伏、桑耶曼荼羅的建立，乃至青朴深巖的伏藏試煉，如今圓滿歸來。切莫以為蓮花生遠在異域——凡有清淨信願與菩提心生起之處，即是銅色吉祥山淨土，吾未曾離汝須臾。今以此幅同框唐卡相贈，願此法炬長明於心，吉祥圓滿！

cues.style: majestic, deep, compassionate enlightened tantric master Guru Padmasambhava
cues.text: Well done, faithful pilgrim! From your first vow beneath Jarung Khashor Stupa through the rains of Yangleshö, the snows of Mangyul, the taming of Yarlha Shampo, the mandala of Samye, and the hidden vaults of Chimphu, you have walked the full path home. Never think Padmasambhava dwells far away—wherever pure faith and bodhicitta arise, there shines the Copper-Colored Mountain, and I am never parted from you. Receive this keepsake Thangka of our meeting in pure vision; may the Dharma lamp shine ever bright in your heart!
